versions.changelog:
seedance-anime-drama 2.0.0

- Major update: now requires ofox-video-core 2.0.0 or newer and enforces the `--approved` flag at runtime for spending safeguards.
- Removed legacy file: `skill-card.md` has been deleted.
- Updated documentation for improved clarity on required core skill versions and spending approval process.
- SKILL.md and changelog files revised to reflect new versioning and requirements.

seedance-anime-drama v1.14.2

- Version bumped to 1.14.2.
- Updated SKILL.md to match new version and metadata.
- Removed skill-card.md file.
- Documentation and metadata improvements for clarity and consistency.

seedance-anime-drama v1.13.1

- Version metadata updated to 1.13.1 in all files.
- Removed obsolete file: skill-card.md.
- No logic or functionality changes; documentation and metadata only.

seedance-anime-drama v1.13.0

- Updated version and metadata to 1.13.0 throughout.
- Minor clarifications and consistency tweaks to documentation for improved accuracy.
- Removed redundant file: skill-card.md.
- No functional or API changes.

seedance-anime-drama 1.12.1

- Updated skill version to 1.12.1 in SKILL.md.
- Documented how to resolve and reference both ofox-image-core and ofox-video-core skill directories at runtime.
- Added a section explaining installation location patterns for core skills across different environments (skills.sh, ClawHub, LobeHub).
- Removed skill-card.md from the skill files.
- No changes to prompt logic or API behavior.

- Clarified the skill’s mechanism: every shot starts on a generated image of the character, ensuring anime-style visual character consistency.
- Refined the creative brief process: the pre-generation user Q&A includes "Let the AI decide" as an option on taste questions, but never on must-ask ones or as a default.
- Documented updates on shot and sequence handling, including new details about multi-shot jobs, hard cuts, and chain-mode for passing frames between shots.
- Expanded safety and usage guidelines, clearly distinguishing when to use this skill vs. others (e.g., not for realistic human dialogue or product/catalog scenes).
- Updated links, references, and brief explanations to align with ofox-image-core and ofox-video-core integration requirements.
